workflowSteps.title: How IDGen Studio Works
workflowSteps.lede: A progressive, 9-stage digital workflow from form definition to batch factory dispatch.

steps.title: Create Your Form
steps.desc: The organization defines the information required for its ID cards.
steps.note: The form can be planned according to the organization's identification requirements.
steps.ctaText: View IDGen Studio Form Planning Template →

steps.title: Share the Form
steps.desc: Once the form is created, the organization can share it using a link or QR code.
steps.note: The intended user simply opens the link or scans the QR code.

steps.title: User Enters Information
steps.desc: The student, parent, employee, participant or other authorized user enters the required information.
steps.note: They can provide their details directly rather than requiring the organization to manually enter every record.

steps.title: Upload Photograph
steps.desc: Where required, the user uploads their identification photograph.
steps.note: This allows the photograph to be associated with the corresponding identification record.

steps.title: Preview the ID Card
steps.desc: Before submitting the information, the user can see the personalized ID card preview.
steps.highlight: The idea is simple: See your ID card before it goes for printing. This creates an opportunity to identify incorrect information before production.

steps.title: Submit
steps.desc: After reviewing the information and preview, the user submits the completed form.
steps.note: The record then becomes available to the organization for review.

steps.title: Organization Reviews
steps.desc: The organization can review submitted records through its IDGen Studio workflow.
steps.note: Where editing is supported, corrections can be made before approval.

steps.title: Approve
steps.desc: Once the organization is satisfied with a record, it can approve it for production.
steps.flowTransition: Submitted → Reviewed → Approved → Ready for Printing

steps.title: Print in Batches
steps.desc: This is one of the key advantages of IDGen Studio. An organization does not necessarily have to wait until everyone has submitted their information.
steps.principle: The principle: Print what is ready instead of waiting for what is not ready.
steps.note: Meanwhile, remaining students, employees or participants can continue submitting their information. Organizations can also choose to process all approved records together when preferred.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.lede: Common questions regarding links, parent submissions, ID card previews, editing and batch printing.

faqs.a: IDGen Studio is a digital ID-card data collection and production workflow that helps organizations collect information and photographs, preview personalized ID cards, review submissions and approve records for printing.

faqs.q: How does a user access the form?
faqs.a: The organization can share a form through a link or QR code. The user opens the link or scans the QR code and completes the required information.
Yes, where the organization's workflow is configured for parent/student submission, parents can enter their child's required information and photograph.

faqs.q: Can users see their ID card before submitting?
faqs.a: Yes, the IDGen Studio workflow is designed to provide an ID card preview before submission.
Yes, submitted records can be reviewed through the organization's IDGen Studio workflow.
Corrections can be made where the configured workflow provides editing access.

faqs.q: Can ID cards be printed in batches?
faqs.a: Yes. Approved records can be processed progressively in batches where the production workflow supports it.

faqs.q: Does the organization have to wait for everyone?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. One of the main advantages of the workflow is that approved records can move toward production while other users continue submitting their information.

faqs.q: Can an organization process all records together?
faqs.a: Yes, where supported by the workflow, an organization can choose to process approved records together rather than progressively.

faqs.q: Can IDGen Studio be used for employees?
faqs.a: Yes. Companies can use the workflow to collect employee identification information and photographs.

faqs.q: Can IDGen Studio be used for events?
faqs.a: Yes. Event organizers can use the workflow for participant data collection and event-card production where the configured workflow supports it.

faqs.q: Do I need a separate app?
faqs.a: No separate app installation is required. Users can access the form through the shared link or QR code using a web browser.
